text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future risk and return, not by whether selling would realize a gain or loss; my large loss sales show that avoiding the pain of a loss is not a strategy.","I should not sell winners just because locking in gains feels good, or buy back a stock simply because its price has fallen; each trade needs a clear rationale and fit with my portfolio plan.","My account value declined despite several trades, so I should use consistent position-size and review rules and avoid letting frequent monitoring turn short-term moves into impulsive decisions."]}
